rationale: Every little-loops repo numbers issues from 1, so same-ID issues across repos are different logical issues (FEAT-3418 discriminator rationale); run_ids are UUIDs unique to one db and idx_issue_events_dedup already dedupes per db, so counts are exactly sum-decomposable without the union view machinery.
rule: Workspace activity counts sum per-repo results; no ATTACH union and no bare issue_id cross-repo dedup
